_comment: Where every recipe's geometry came from, by NODE ID. Read scripts/check_provenance.py
and the Refresh section of SKILL.md before editing.
This file exists because the source map used to cite frame names and headline text.
Three of its twenty rows named a headline that is not a frame name, two rows claimed a
board another recipe also claimed, and none of it could be checked against the file. A
name is a claim; a node id is checkable. REG-24 is the guard.
It is also what makes a periodic refresh possible. Re-pull the section, diff the board
inventory against `boards` below, and you get added, removed and renamed boards in one
pass instead of reading prose and guessing.
Most boards are authored at 1940.4 x 1092.4 and normalise to the 1920 x 1080 canvas.
ONE IS NOT: 1659:1020 is already 1920 x 1080, so its child coordinates are final and
applying the factors below to them introduces a 1% error. Check the board size before
